sources.title: Introducing Arete-27B: Qwen3.8-27B Post-Trained To Reinforce Western ...
sources.snippet: We post-trained Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B to reinforce Western values on a Chinese-trained model, and measured what changed with an 803-prompt eval across seven value categories.

sources.title: Nous Research Releases Arete-27B that Cuts Qwen3.8-27B Propaganda From ...
sources.snippet: Nous Research has released Arete-27B, a supervised fine-tune of Alibaba’s Qwen3.8-27B. Arete-27B is a 27B open-weight model that strips Chinese state framing from Qwen’s answers. On Nous’s own 803-prompt eval, answers containing propaganda fell from 22% to 0.9%. Developers get Qwen-class agentic skill without state-aligned answers.
